summary.text: Bill Hardwick is a Republican state representative from Missouri House District 121 and the Republican candidate for Missouri Senate District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney who has served in the U.S. Army and the Missouri National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Bill Hardwick was born in Rolla, Missouri, lives in Waynesville, and graduated from Dixon High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in classics and a J.D. from the University of Missouri.
His career experience includes work as a special assistant U.S. attorney, an assistant prosecuting attorney in Pulaski County and city prosecutor in St. Robert.
Hardwick is not running for re-election to House District 121 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Judiciary Committee and the Joint Committee on Legislative Research; in 2023-2024 he chaired the Emerging Issues Committee.
